mapper.sql: select h.id, h.page_key as pageKey, h.season_id as seasonId, coalesce(s.display_title, s.season_name) as seasonName, h.mode, h.image_file_id as imageFileId, img.access_url as imageUrl, h.mobile_image_file_id as mobileImageFileId, mob.access_url as mobileImageUrl, h.focus_x as focusX, h.focus_y as focusY, h.mask_opacity as maskOpacity, h.alt_text as altText, h.hero_status as heroStatus, h.has_draft as hasDraft, h.draft_mode as draftMode, h.draft_image_file_id as draftImageFileId, dimg.access_url as draftImageUrl, h.draft_mobile_image_file_id as draftMobileImageFileId, dmob.access_url as draftMobileImageUrl, h.draft_focus_x as draftFocusX, h.draft_focus_y as draftFocusY, h.draft_mask_opacity as draftMaskOpacity, h.draft_alt_text as draftAltText, h.draft_enabled as draftEnabled, h.version_no as versionNo from basket_page_hero h left join basket_season s on s.id = h.season_id and h.season_id <> 0 and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_file_asset img on img.id = h.image_file_id and img.is_delete = 0 left join basket_file_asset mob on mob.id = h.mobile_image_file_id and mob.is_delete = 0 left join basket_file_asset dimg on dimg.id = h.draft_image_file_id and dimg.is_delete = 0 left join basket_file_asset dmob on dmob.id = h.draft_mobile_image_file_id and dmob.is_delete = 0
mapper.select: where h.is_delete = 0 and h.page_key = #{pageKey} and h.season_id = #{seasonId}
where h.is_delete = 0 and h.season_id = 0 and h.page_key in ('DATA', 'HALL', 'ANNOUNCEMENT', 'PARTNER') order by h.page_key

select id, page_key, season_id, mode, image_file_id, mobile_image_file_id, focus_x, focus_y, mask_opacity, alt_text, hero_status, has_draft, draft_mode, draft_image_file_id, draft_mobile_image_file_id, draft_focus_x, draft_focus_y, draft_mask_opacity, draft_alt_text, draft_enabled, version_no, active_key, update_by, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_page_hero where is_delete = 0 and page_key = #{pageKey} and season_id = #{seasonId} limit 1 for update
